notes.title: Version 1.2.6 - Updated Menus, Added FPS Limit and Achievements Button
notes.notes:
Brave Vikings,

We are upgrading our Menus to bring you new features and make more options available in-game, which were only accessible via the main menu before.
Also, we have several bug fixes included for you. Check out the list below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40121402/bcd4d0428ecfbf5906693d406f9790000c1037b7.png[/img]

Full Changelog:
- Visual rework of all menus
- Add new Menu Options to Pause Menu in Raids and Overworld Maps
- Add button to quickly view Achievements
- Add FPS Limit (to save battery on mobile devices, such as Steam Deck or Notebooks)

Happy Dating!

notes.title: Doki Doki Ragnarok Release Delayed to Valentine’s Day
notes.notes:
Hi Vikings,

We’re sorry to announce that our release date will be delayed to February 14th, 2022.
Some of our team members had private issues, which delayed their work.
So in order to keep our mental health and motivation up high, we decided to delay the game.

With that said, we are making steady progress on the game and are already working on the final country! We can’t wait for you to get a look at the last dates we have planned for you vikings!

notes.title: Version 0.8.2 - Steam Achievements & Cloud Save
notes.notes:
Hey Vikings,

As this Update brings all Steam features that we can implement before release:
- Steam Cloud Save
- Steam Achievements

Furthermore we have further improvements for controllers and backing up your save games:
- Improved Controller Support (Xbox, PS4, Switch and more)
- Add Fast-Forward Controller Button (Xbox: X | PS4: Square | Switch: Y)
- Save files are now written to disk (instead of Windows Registry and other hard-to-backup locations)

And we are almost finished with Sweden! That leaves us with one more country to go before our release ❤️🪓
